{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in early periods, showing significant lag that gradually corrects as predictions extend further into the future",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with higher forecast values, but the model under-reacts to sentiment shifts in the first 15-day horizon",
    "Mean reversion bias exists where model predictions approach historical means rather than tracking true price momentum",
    "Forecast overshoot occurs in both directions - initially lagging behind true outcomes, then converging to slightly different levels than the final stabilized forecasts",
    "When sentiment turns negative (-0.33), model forecasts remain too high by 1-3 euros compared to true outcomes",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes narrows systematically from day 1 to day 30, suggesting an initialization lag in the prediction system"
